scope: Proof frontend access-exchange error isolation and terminal-session response guards
behavior: Rejected or unavailable link exchanges show link-unavailable without loading an existing cookie's order or calling remote session cleanup
Exchange failures are typed by stage rather than inferred solely from the current URL
Non-authorization exchange failures do not claim the link has expired
Authenticated order401 and actual session expiry retain fail-closed cleanup
Late queued, background, extension, completed-action, proof-update and feedback responses cannot restore a locally ended or expired ready state
Custom PDF controls, Share scope, reviewer form guards, refresh continuity and API contracts remain intact

validation.isolation: Synthetic localhost API only; browser tests block external traffic. No live tokens in fixtures.

excluded: Backend, API, grant, cookie policy or permission changes
Intake, Wrike, Status or Admin runtime changes
Live proof decisions, uploads, emails or reviewer identity saves
limitations: This fixes a source-confirmed existing failure path; the precise cause of the reported live link rejection was not captured
Synthetic viewer and session tests do not replace remaining authorized live Proof smoke or future post-deployment verification
Prior private rollback remains valid; the prior candidate Proof artifact is superseded and must not be published as this fix
